Interface RMIServerInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIServerInterfaceImpl
public interface RMIServerInterface extends Remote
Remote interface exposing all the callable actions a server provides to its RMI clients. It strictly dictates lobby interactions, match manipulation, and gameplay commands accessible over Java RMI calls.
